dataset: ICDAR 2019 cTDaR public training annotation repository
parser: parse_pdf_document on one-page image-only PDFs; no table recognition model

definitions.table_detection: diagnostic axis-aligned-envelope IoU at 0.50 plus cTDaR official polygon-IoU thresholds 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.9
definitions.cell_structure: one-to-one axis-aligned-envelope IoU matching at threshold 0.50
definitions.official_track_b_structure: reimplementation of public cTDaR evaluator: table matching at polygon IoU >= 0.8; match cells at each reported IoU; score directed horizontal/vertical adjacency relation precision and recall
definitions.grid: cell start/end row and column spans are parsed; exact span agreement is additionally reported on geometrically matched cells
limitations: These are public training/development annotations, not a held-out official test set
The current parser emits no scanned-table regions or cells, so Track B relation precision is undefined (no predicted relations) and recall is zero
Diagnostic envelope metrics are not the official cTDaR polygon metric

exact_grid_coordinates.note: Current parser output has row/column attributes but no predictions exist for scanned cTDaR images; spans are included for completeness.
